 ​K-drama Star Song Joong-ki’s Expression Goes Viral After Bystanders Mention Song Hye-kyo
 Entertainment and Celebrity News Trending & Features 
 October 27, 2026 
 David Ruiz 
 ​ Descendants of the Sun star Song Joong-ki recently went viral on social media after a video circulated online showing him looking visibly displeased when a bystander referred to him as “the person who married Song Hye-kyo.”
 Photo: @joy_undo/X
 ​The incident occurred during one of the actor’s personal trips. A crowd of fans spotted him on a street—wearing an oversized sweatshirt, denim pants, and a cap while surrounded by bodyguards—and greeted him warmly. 
 During the brief interaction, Song Joong-ki smiled and greeted them back until a bystander asked who he was, prompting another individual in the crowd to identify him as Song Hye-kyo’s former husband. 
 宋仲基听到宋慧乔名字后，脸都变形了，究竟是怎么回事 ？？？ https://t.co/WM3z5kqRwH
 — 武大郎 (@joy_undo) October 19, 2026 
 ​Netizens who posted the footage alleged that Song Joong-ki’s facial expression instantly shifted from a smile to a grimace upon hearing his ex-wife’s name. 
 ​ “Song Joong-ki unable to hide his expression after hearing his ex-wife’s name from fans,” the publisher of the video wrote in the caption. 
 ​ “Song Joong-ki’s face twisted up the moment he heard Song Hye-kyo’s name—what on earth is going on???” another netizen posted on X (formerly Twitter). 
 View this post on Instagram 
 A post shared by 송중기 songjoongki official (@hi_songjoongki) 
 ​Despite the awkward moment, footage showed the actor quickly composing himself and returning to smiling at his fans. 
 ​A divided netizen reaction 
 ​The viral clip quickly sparked a heated debate online. Some netizens criticized Song Joong-ki’s reaction, arguing that he was being overly sensitive or feeling slighted that people still associate him with his ex-wife. 
 On the other hand, many fans rushed to his defense, calling the bystander’s remark disrespectful and unnecessary, especially since the actor has moved on and built a new family. 
 송중기 해외 길거리 영상 논란 ㄷㄷ
 길 가다가 해외 팬이 “쟤 누구임?” 하니까 다른 사람이 대놓고 “송혜교랑 결혼했던 애” 이래서 송중기 표정 싹 굳은 영상 뜸…
 아니 미친 거 아님? 재혼해서 애가 둘인 사람한테 대놓고 저러는 건 뭔 심보냐 진짜ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ 무례함 레전드 ㄷㄷ https://t.co/bx10CtiR9W
 — 사란이 (@Hyojung8281) October 21, 2026 
 ​ “No way, isn’t that insane? What’s the deal blurting that out to a remarried guy with two kids?” a fan wrote on X. 
 ​Looking back and moving forward 
 ​Song Joong-ki and Song Hye-kyo—popularly dubbed the “Song-Song couple”—rose to massive global popularity in 2016 following the mega-hit success of the KBS drama series Descendants of the Sun . 
 The couple tied the knot in October 2017, but their marriage came to an end when they announced their divorce in July 2019, just a year and nine months later. 
 View this post on Instagram 
 A post shared by 송중기 songjoongki official (@hi_songjoongki) 
 ​Both stars have since closed that chapter and moved on with their respective personal and professional lives. Song Joong-ki married British actress Katy Louise Saunders in January 2023, and the couple now shares two children—a son born in 2023 and a daughter born in late 2024. 
 View this post on Instagram 
 A post shared by 송중기 songjoongki official (@hi_songjoongki) 
 Meanwhile, Song Hye-kyo continued to dominate the screen, making a powerful career comeback in Netflix’s thriller series The Glory , which earned her the prestigious Best Actress award at the 59th Baeksang Arts Awards in 2023.
